about: A meadow on a bright day, and the arena of Kitten Survivors. GENERATED — run `node tools/make-kitten-survivors-meadow.mjs` to rebuild it; edits made here are lost on the next run. The top of the ground is y = 0. Inside the fence at 45 nothing the arena draws is taller than 0.5 m, so nothing hides the crowd. Every prop inside the fence sits in one narrow warm value band, and the creatures are the only dark things on screen. The direction every other lane matches is kitten-survivors/art/world/bible.md. Enemies are not placed here: a survivor's crowd arrives on a clock, not out of a level file.
